about: Generated by tools/gen_todo_nodes.py. ComfyUI node classes SwarmUI can emit that comfy-server does not implement yet.

other_arch.title: Other model architectures
other_arch.swarm_params: Stock ComfyUI nodes for model families beyond the five targets (SD1/SDXL, SD3, Flux, Wan, LTX-V, Hunyuan, Cosmos, ...). Routed to Engine::custom_node when the engine claims them

third_party.title: Third-party custom nodes (optional features)
third_party.swarm_params: SwarmUI only uses these when the backend advertises them; real ComfyUI needs extra node packs for them. Routed to Engine::custom_node when the engine claims them

object_info.name: EmptyHiDreamO1LatentImage
object_info.description: Empty pixel-space latent for HiDream-O1-Image. The model was trained at ~4 megapixels; lower resolutions go off-distribution and quality regresses noticeably. Trained resolutions: 2048x2048, 2304x1728, 1728x2304, 2560x1440, 1440x2560, 2496x1664, 1664x2496, 3104x1312, 1312x3104, 2304x1792, 1792x2304.

object_info.name: EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio
object_info.description: Creates an empty MiniMax Music3 audio latent for the requested duration.

object_info.name: FluxDisableGuidance
object_info.description: This node completely disables the guidance embed on Flux and Flux like models

model.tooltip: The model to use KV Cache on.

output_tooltips: The patched model with KV Cache enabled.
object_info.name: FluxKVCache
object_info.description: Enables KV Cache optimization for reference images on Flux family models.

start_percent.tooltip: Sampling progress (0=start, 1=end) at which the blend turns ON.

end_percent.tooltip: Sampling progress at which the blend turns OFF.

pattern.tooltip: Shift layout. single_shift: one pass at the natural patch grid + others offset. symmetric: all passes off-grid, shifts split around origin.

passes.tooltip: Number of passes per gated step. 2/4 = fixed. ramp_*: pass count increases as sampling approaches end (more smoothing where seams are most visible).

blend.tooltip: average: equal-weight mean. window: Hann-windowed weighting favoring each pass away from its patch boundaries. median: per-pixel median, rejects wraparound-outlier passes.

strength.tooltip: Interpolation between the natural-grid pred (0) and the averaged result (1).

object_info.name: HiDreamO1PatchSeamSmoothing
object_info.description: Average the model output across multiple shifted patch-grid positions during the late portion of sampling. Cancels seams.

images.tooltip: Reference images are used in numeric socket order.

object_info.name: HiDreamO1ReferenceImages
object_info.description: Attach ordered reference images to positive and negative conditioning.

object_info.description:
Recipes:

image.tooltip: Image or video to condition the latent video on. Must be 8*n + 1 frames. If the video is not 8*n + 1 frames, it will be cropped to the nearest 8*n + 1 frames.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to start the conditioning at. For single-frame images or videos with 1-8 frames, any frame_idx value is acceptable. For videos with 9+ frames, frame_idx must be divisible by 8, otherwise it will be rounded down to the nearest multiple of 8. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

attention_mask.tooltip: Optional pixel-space spatial mask. Controls per-region conditioning influence via self-attention, multiplied by strength.

iclora_parameters.tooltip: Optional IC-LoRA parameters from a Get IC-LoRA Parameters node. Used for adjusting guide processing as required by certain IC-LoRAs (eg. those with a reference_downscale_factor > 1). When chained, each LTXVAddGuide uses only the parameters connected to it.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model used for decoding the latent.
The Audio VAE model to use for encoding.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

img_compression.tooltip: Amount of compression to apply on image.

reference_audio.tooltip: Reference audio clip whose speaker identity to transfer. ~5 seconds recommended (training duration). Shorter or longer clips may degrade voice identity transfer.

identity_guidance_scale.tooltip: Strength of identity guidance. Runs an extra forward pass without reference each step to amplify speaker identity. Set to 0 to disable (no extra pass).

start_percent.tooltip: Start of the sigma range where identity guidance is active.

end_percent.tooltip: End of the sigma range where identity guidance is active.

object_info.name: LTXVReferenceAudio
object_info.description: Set reference audio for ID-LoRA speaker identity transfer. Encodes a reference audio clip into the conditioning and optionally patches the model with identity guidance (extra forward pass without reference, amplifying the speaker identity effect).

MiDaS-DepthMapPreprocessor.note: ControlNet preprocessors (comfyui_controlnet_aux); any node in category image/preprocessors is offered.

max_duration.tooltip: Maximum duration in seconds; the model can end the song earlier.

object_info.name: MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode
object_info.description: Uses a MiniMax Music3 CLIP model to generate the acoustic conditioning sequence.

latent_format.tooltip: Flux1 (16-ch) and Flux2 (128-ch) latents are auto-detected from channel dim under 'flux'. For SD3 (16-ch), SDXL (4-ch), or QwenImage (16-ch), select manually.

degrade_sigma.tooltip: 0 = clean latent. Increase to denoise corrupted latent outputs.

object_info.name: PiDConditioning
object_info.description: Attaches a latent and a degrade_sigma scalar to a CONDITIONING for PiD decoding/upscaling

object_info.name: SwarmOffsetEmptyLatentImage
object_info.description: Generates a latent image with 4 channels, each channel filled with a different offset value. Designed to allow alternate empty value offsets for SDv1 and SDXL.

image_interleave.tooltip: How much the image influences things vs the text prompt. Higher number means more influence from the text prompt.

object_info.name: TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus
object_info.display_name: Text Encode Qwen Image Edit Plus

ref_pad_image.tooltip: Fills the padding frames of the image conditioning with this image instead of gray, anchoring identity without pinning frames (SVI-style anti-drift padding, used by models such as ID-V2V).

mode.tooltip: full: generates melody and chords; melody: generates melody only, recommended for covers.

penalty_window.tooltip: Number of recent ABC tokens used to penalize repetition.

object_info.name: YuE2GenerateABC
object_info.description: Generates the ABC notation of a song from style and lyrics. Connect abc to YuE2 Generate Music node.

abc.tooltip: Connect the ABC generator or supply an edited score. Leave empty to use off mode automatically.

mode.tooltip: full: generates melody and chords; melody: generates melody only, recommended for covers.

max_duration.tooltip: Maximum duration in seconds. Automatically reduced for long prompts; generation can stop earlier.

cfg_scale.tooltip: Autoregressive guidance for style and lyrics. 1.0 disables CFG, matching the ABC workflow. Use 1.01 to match the original off-mode guidance.

object_info.name: YuE2GenerateMusic
object_info.description: Generates music tokens and acoustic conditioning from style, lyrics, and an ABC notation. Provide the generated seconds to the Empty YuE2 Latent Audio node. An empty ABC input ignores the selected mode.
